sv.title: Magyars Ukrainabesök ”nytt kapitel” i relationer
sv.summary: Péter Magyar träffade Ukrainas president Volodymyr Zelenskyj under sitt första besök i Ukraina i rollen som premiärminister. Tisdagens besök signalerar ett nytt kapitel i ländernas tidigare frostiga relationer.

en.title: Magyar's Ukraine visit a "new chapter" in relations
en.summary: Péter Magyar met Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy during his first visit to Ukraine as prime minister. Tuesday's visit signals a new chapter in the countries' previously frosty relations.
